user.title: FoxESS Cloud Open API
user.description: Generate an API key at foxesscloud.com > User Profile > API Management.

error.invalid_auth: API key rejected by FoxESS Cloud.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach FoxESS Cloud (or rate limited).
error.no_devices: No inverters found on this account.

init.title: Polling
init.description: FoxESS allows 1440 API calls per inverter per day. Real-time = 1 call per poll; settings = 4 calls per poll.

force_charge.name: Force charge window
force_charge.description: Writes a ForceCharge window and enables the scheduler. By default keeps the other enabled groups (e.g. the SelfUse base) and replaces only existing force-charge groups.

device_sn.name: Inverter SN
device_sn.description: Optional, defaults to the first configured inverter.

end_time.name: End
end_time.description: Window end. Windows crossing midnight are split in two.

target_soc.name: Target SoC
target_soc.description: fdSoc: charging stops at this SoC.

min_soc_on_grid.name: Min SoC on grid
min_soc_on_grid.description: Defaults to the current on-grid min SoC.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: ForceCharge or ForceCharge(BAT), as reported by the inverter.

replace_all.name: Replace all groups
replace_all.description: If on, discards all other groups and writes only the charge window.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule (raw)
set_schedule.description: Writes scheduler groups (Scheduler V1 format) and optionally enables the scheduler.

enable_scheduler.name: Enable scheduler
enable_scheduler.description: Turn the master switch on after writing.

disable_scheduler.name: Disable scheduler
disable_scheduler.description: Turns the scheduler master switch off.

get_setting.name: Get device setting
get_setting.description: Returns value, unit and range of a setting.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the scheduler groups and their allowed ranges.
